postalAuthorityFindings.operator: Agencia Boliviana de Correos / Correos de Bolivia

applicationEvidence.reason: Bolivia has no postcode search key or eligible real postal Polygon/MultiPolygon. Shared runtime/UI tests verify fail-closed area contracts but cannot promote tracking identifiers, P.O. Box numbers, administrative areas or foreign polygons.

reproducibility.pdfInspection: pdfplumber scanned all 13 physical pages across two exact byte/SHA-256-bound PDFs and validated edition, address examples and the physical-page-4 Bolivia no-postcode marker
reproducibility.pdfRender: Poppler rendered the Bolivia page to a non-empty 1275x1650 RGB PNG with sha256:205cd9f69e54bc1aa2927025faeb5c01bf9818c704bc053d880ec847dfcfff82 and General Addressing Issues physical page 4 to a non-empty 1241x1754 RGB PNG with sha256:16192d1a73cc7ff9734c124088b96e4a6c1145e3aa83078e58aa934d5cca3ec6; the local image-view helper failed with Windows error 206 even through a short mapped path
reproducibility.featureQuery: none; only ArcGIS item, FeatureServer and layer metadata were inspected
reproducibility.geometryTransformation: none; no address, office, code, coordinate, feature or geometry was copied, transformed or promoted into Git
reproducibility.visualizationDecision: No chart was added because the authoritative denominator is zero postcodes and zero eligible postal geometry; a chart would imply a measurable postal-area dataset.
reproducibility.reportDelivery: The repository Markdown country report is the rollout's required durable canonical surface; no new public destination was created.

limitations: The current UPU evidence establishes that Bolivia does not require postcodes; it does not authorize inventing a placeholder code or postal surface.
The AGBC portal distinguishes shipment tracking, P.O. Box services and offices but publishes no postcode assignment or geometry dataset.
The generic BO M0 address-format inventory's optional postcode placeholder is not postal authority and cannot enable a real BO search route.
AGBC copyright and public access do not establish compatible data rights; its reviewed terms link has no published target.
The ArcGIS Polygon result is in Colombia, outside Bolivia, and has empty licence metadata.
No real BO browser E2E was run because no valid BO postcode input or eligible immutable BO postal area artifact exists.
